changelog:
- Initial release of the review-llm-artifacts skill.
- Detects artifacts left by LLM coding agents in four categories: tests, dead code, abstraction, and style.
- Automatically scans only changed files by default; use `--all` to scan the full project.
- Supports parallel review passes per category with subagents when available; otherwise, runs sequentially.
- Produces a structured JSON report with all findings, assigning unique IDs and grouping by category.
- Includes strict checks and gating to ensure all categories are reviewed and reported before summarizing results.
